source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U04: Apply timely return,accretions,necessary expenses and qualified liens

payload.title: Return duties and retention rights must be read together
payload.core_explanation_md:
When the agreed time expires or purpose is accomplished,the bailee must follow the return/disposal obligation. Wrongful delay and the treatment of any increase or profit from the goods require separate reconciliation. A gratuitous custody arrangement also has the stated necessary-expense rule;free service does not mean every properly incurred cost is personally absorbed.

A particular lien for qualifying labour or skill differs from the specified general-lien categories. Contract terms,credit arrangements and the purpose of delivery can qualify retention. A right to retain is not automatically an unrestricted right to sell;do not use a banker label to bypass the actual custody terms.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every retention right automatically include sale?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Establish the relevant lien or security power and its limits.

payload.stem_md: A service provider agreed to deliver on credit but later assumes an unconditional right to retain the goods for immediate cash. What is relevant?

options.text_md: A rule that every bailee may sell immediately
The agreed credit/delivery terms and the applicable lien conditions
options.explanation_md: The source recognises that contract can qualify retention.
Margin does not determine the right.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source recognises that contract can qualify retention.

payload.stem_md: An additional benefit arises from the bailed goods and no contrary contract is stipulated. What should the return reconciliation consider?

options.text_md: The source rule for accretions or profit along with the goods
options.explanation_md: The benefit cannot simply be ignored.

options.text_md: The bailee automatically owns every increase
options.explanation_md: That is not the stated default.

options.text_md: Return of the original goods cancels every other duty
The goods become a bank deposit
options.explanation_md: The custody relationship has not changed into that debt.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The benefit cannot simply be ignored.
